register.pageTitle: Register with a clan invitation code
register.pageDescription: Account registration for the clan portal, using a clan invitation code.
register.codeTitle: Enter the phả with your clan invitation code
register.codeIntro: This portal belongs to one particular dòng họ, so accounts open only with an invitation code. The Hội đồng Tộc biểu issues one code for the whole clan — you will have received it in a message, or read it from a printed invitation card.
register.codeHint: Type it exactly as printed. Hyphens, spaces and lower case are all fine — the system ignores them. So are the letter O and the digit 0.
register.codeEmpty: Please type your clan invitation code.
register.codeWhyFirst: The code is checked first and the account is created afterwards. Getting the code wrong creates nothing at all, so you can try as often as you need.
register.noCodeBody: The clan issues accounts person by person; there is no open sign-up. Ask your Trưởng chi, or anyone in the family who is already in — the code is issued to the whole clan, so anyone holding it can pass it on. Meanwhile the public part of the phả stays open to you.
register.haveAccount: I already have an account — sign in
register.alreadySignedIn: You are already signed in. Entering a code above opens the phả for the account you are using; it does not create a second one.
register.accountTitle: The code works — now create your account
register.accountForClan: This code opens the portal of {clan}.
register.accountForClanUnknown: This code opens the clan portal.
register.identifierHint: This is what you will sign in with from now on — an email address or a phone number, either works. Any format of a Vietnamese number is accepted: 0912 345 678, 0912.345.678 and +84912345678 are the same number. Please use your own, not one shared with someone else in the household — one account per person is what lets the genealogy record who changed what.
register.identifierEmpty: Please give your email address or phone number.
register.nameHint: A name for the system to greet you by, and for the Trưởng chi to see who has just registered. It is not your name in the phả: the system never uses it to guess who you are — you point that out yourself in the next step, and the Trưởng chi approves it.

NOT_FOUND.title: No invitation matches this code
NOT_FOUND.body: The code you typed does not match any clan invitation. The usual causes are a link cut short when a message was forwarded, or one missing character — the letter O and the digit 0 look nearly alike in print, and so do I and 1.
NOT_FOUND.next: Please type it again, checking it character by character against the card or the message. If it still does not open, the code is not for this clan — ask whoever gave it to you.

EXPIRED.title: This invitation code has expired
EXPIRED.body: A clan invitation code only works for a limited time, so that a card forgotten in a drawer cannot open the phả years later. Yours was right once; it is simply old now.
EXPIRED.next: Typing it again will not help here. Ask whoever gave you the code for a new one — the Hội đồng Tộc biểu can issue one in minutes, and you will not have to start over.

REVOKED.title: This invitation code has been withdrawn
REVOKED.body: This is different from expiry: somebody closed this code deliberately. Usually it is because the code spread beyond the clan, and the Hội đồng Tộc biểu closed it to protect the records of living people. It is not aimed at you, and nobody who already joined with it is affected.
REVOKED.next: Ask whoever gave you the code, or your Trưởng chi, for the code that is current now.

EXHAUSTED.title: This invitation code has run out of uses
EXHAUSTED.body: The code is still in date and has not been withdrawn. But the Hội đồng Tộc biểu set a ceiling on how many people may register with it — that ceiling is how the council can tell whether a code is leaking — and it has just been reached.
EXHAUSTED.next: This is the one case that reopens without a new code: message whoever gave it to you. Raising the ceiling or issuing a fresh code both take a few minutes.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Please try again in a few minutes
RATE_LIMITED.body: Too many code attempts have come from this device in a short time, so the system has paused — this is the layer that stops codes being guessed by machine. It is not your fault, and your code is still perfectly good.
RATE_LIMITED.next: Please wait a few minutes and type it again. While you wait, the public part of the phả is open just below.
RATE_LIMITED.nextAfter: Please wait about {minutes} minutes and type it again. While you wait, the public part of the phả is open just below.

PROVIDER_DOWN.title: The account could not be created just now
PROVIDER_DOWN.body: Your invitation code is right and is still intact. The trouble is in the sign-in account service, on our side — and the part that matters most: the code has not been counted as used.
PROVIDER_DOWN.next: Please wait a moment, then press “Try again”. You do not need a new code, and you do not have to start over.

UNAVAILABLE.title: The invitation code could not be checked
UNAVAILABLE.body: This is a connection problem between your device and the system, not a wrong code.
UNAVAILABLE.next: Please check your network, then press “Try again”. Your invitation code is still good.

IDENTITY_TAKEN.title: Please sign in, then enter the code again
IDENTITY_TAKEN.body: The email address or phone number you entered may already have been used to sign in before — including through Google or Zalo, which set no password at all, so it is easy to forget you have an account. Signing up with a clan code does not ask for a password, so the system stops here rather than touching an account it cannot be sure is yours. Your invitation code is still valid and still has uses left.
IDENTITY_TAKEN.next: Press “Sign in, then enter the code”, sign in with that same identifier — it may be the Google or Zalo button — then come back and type the clan code once more; by then the system knows who you are and will carry on. If you cannot sign in at all, give this invitation code to your chi head or the Hội đồng Tộc biểu and they will help. And please do not press create-account repeatedly: every attempt counts against the anti-probing limit for the device you are on.

register.doneBody: You are through the clan's front door. This account is not yet tied to anyone in the phả, and that is correct rather than unfinished: the code is issued to the whole clan, so the system does not know which person in it you are — guessing by matching names is the quickest way to hand one family's record to somebody else.
register.donePasswordTitle: One thing left: set a password
register.donePasswordBody: The password link works once and expires after thirty minutes. If it lapses you can ask for another; nothing is lost.
register.doneHasPasswordTitle: This account already has a password
register.doneHasPasswordBody: The email address or phone number you entered already has an account with a password, so no reset link is issued — issuing one would let anyone holding a clan code change someone else's password. Just sign in as usual.
register.doneNextTitle: Next: point out who you are in the phả
register.doneNextBody: Open the phả đồ, find your own place in it and send a claim. Your Trưởng chi checks it against the records and approves it; only after that can you correct your family's part and receive giỗ reminders for your chi.
register.doneNextNote: You can browse the phả đồ before that approval — you have to see the phả in order to find yourself in it.
register.doneNextCta: Who am I in the phả
register.donePasswordPhoneRecovery: You registered with a phone number, so please remember the password you just set: password-reset links are sent by email, and this account has no email address. If you forget it, call your branch head — they can reopen it for you.
register.signInThenCode: Sign in, then enter the code
register.doneAlreadySignedInTitle: You were already signed in — no password to set
register.doneAlreadySignedInBody: You entered the code while signed in, so the system opened the gate for the account you are already using rather than creating a second one. That is also why there is no set-password link: you already have a way in. Next time, just sign in as usual.

invitation.pageTitle: An invitation to join the phả
invitation.pageDescription: The invitation page of the clan portal.
invitation.expiresOn: This invitation code works until the end of {date}.
invitation.benefitsTitle: If you accept, you will be able to:
invitation.benefit1: see the people of the clan, including those still living
invitation.benefit2: look up danh xưng — the right term to call each relative
invitation.benefit3: receive reminders for the giỗ (death anniversaries) of your chi (branch)
invitation.benefit4: ask for a correction when something is recorded wrongly
invitation.noWaiting: No waiting for approval: the person who invited you named you directly, so the account is already linked to the profile above.
invitation.nextStep: Accepting is all it takes: your account is linked to the profile above straight away.
invitation.accept: That is me — accept the invitation
invitation.acceptFailed: The invitation could not be accepted. This is a connection problem, not a problem with your code. Please press again.
invitation.needsAccountLead: You are not signed in yet. Give an email address or phone number so the system can open an account and link it to the profile above right away — no approval needed.
invitation.needsAccountSubmit: That is me — open an account
invitation.needsAccountHaveOne: I already have an account — sign in
invitation.createdTitle: Account opened — one thing left: set a password
invitation.createdBody: Your account is already linked to the profile above; nobody needs to approve it. Press the button below to set a password; the link works once and expires after thirty minutes.
invitation.declineHint: Pressing “This is not me” cancels this invitation code and tells the person who sent it. After that, nobody can use the code.
invitation.declineConfirmBody: You are about to cancel the invitation code sent to {name}. Three things happen at once and cannot be undone: the code stops working for everyone; the person who invited you is notified; and joining the phả will need a new invitation code.
invitation.declineFailed: The code could not be cancelled. Please try again.
invitation.declinedTitle: This invitation code has been cancelled
invitation.declinedBody: The person who sent the invitation will be notified. If you pressed it by mistake, please call them for a new invitation code — the old one cannot be reused.
invitation.contactFallbackTitle: If you need help, call the person who invited you
invitation.contactFallbackBody: Their phone number is at the end of the message, or at the bottom of the paper invitation. They are a member of the clan, not a call centre.

EXPIRED.title: This invitation code has expired
EXPIRED.body: Each invitation code works for seven days from when it was sent, so that a mislaid paper slip cannot open the phả later on. The code you opened is past that.
EXPIRED.next: Please call the person who invited you and say you need a new code. They can issue one straight away; nothing has to start over.

ALREADY_USED.title: This invitation code has already been used
ALREADY_USED.body: Each invitation code opens only once. If you accepted this invitation earlier, you no longer need the code — just log in.
ALREADY_USED.next: If you never used this code, please call the person who invited you right away: the message may have reached the wrong person, and they need to know.

NOT_FOUND.title: No invitation could be opened with this code
NOT_FOUND.body: The code does not match any invitation. The usual causes are a link cut short when a message was forwarded, or one character missed when typing — the letter O and the digit zero are easy to confuse.
NOT_FOUND.next: Please open the exact link in the message from the person who invited you, or retype the code printed on the paper invitation. If it still fails, call them.

REVOKED.title: This invitation code has been cancelled
REVOKED.body: Someone pressed “This is not me” on this invitation, so the code was cancelled to keep the phả safe.
REVOKED.next: If that was you by mistake, please call the person who invited you for a new code.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Please try again in a few minutes
RATE_LIMITED.body: Too many invitations have been opened from this device at once, so the system has paused to stop code guessing.
RATE_LIMITED.next: Please wait a few minutes, then open the exact link from the message again. If it is urgent, call the person who invited you.

UNAVAILABLE.title: The invitation could not be opened
UNAVAILABLE.body: This is a connection problem between your device and the system, not a problem with the invitation code.
UNAVAILABLE.next: Please check your network, then press “Try again”. Your invitation code is still valid.

NEEDS_ACCOUNT.title: This step needs you to log in first
NEEDS_ACCOUNT.body: Your invitation code is still valid — the problem is not the code. To attach the invitation to one account, the system needs to know which account is yours.
NEEDS_ACCOUNT.next: If you already have a clan account, please log in and then reopen the exact link from the message. If you have never had an account, please call the person who invited you — only someone in the clan can open a new one for you.

ACCOUNT_ALREADY_LINKED.title: This account is already linked to someone else in the phả
ACCOUNT_ALREADY_LINKED.body: Each account can be linked to only one person in the phả. If you accepted an invitation earlier, you no longer need this code.
ACCOUNT_ALREADY_LINKED.next: If you believe the account is linked to the wrong person, please call the person who invited you or the Hội đồng Tộc biểu (clan council) — only the council can unlink and relink.

PERSON_ALREADY_LINKED.title: Someone has already accepted this invitation
PERSON_ALREADY_LINKED.body: The profile in the phả that this invitation points to has already been claimed by another account.
PERSON_ALREADY_LINKED.next: If that was not you, please call the person who invited you right away: the invitation may have reached the wrong person, and they need to know.

IDENTITY_TAKEN.title: Please sign in, then open the invitation again
IDENTITY_TAKEN.body: The invitation code is still perfectly good — the problem is not the code. The email address or phone number you entered may already have been used to sign in before, including through Google or Zalo, which set no password at all, so it is easy to forget you have an account. Accepting an invitation does not ask for a password, so the system stops rather than linking the invitation to an account it cannot be sure is yours.
IDENTITY_TAKEN.next: Press “Sign in”, sign in with that same identifier — it may be the Google or Zalo button — then reopen the link from your message; by then the system knows who you are and can accept the invitation. If you cannot sign in at all, give this invitation code to your chi head and they will help. And please do not press accept repeatedly: every attempt counts against the anti-probing limit for the device you are on.

invitation.acceptedTitle: Done — you are now in the phả
invitation.acceptedBody: Your account is linked to the profile above. There is nothing to wait for, and the invitation code is no longer needed.
invitation.acceptedOpenProfile: View my profile in the phả
invitation.acceptedSignInHint: Your account already has a password, so simply sign in as usual to view the genealogy.

setPassword.pageDescription: Page for setting the first password on an account that has just accepted an invitation.
setPassword.title: Set a password for your account
setPassword.intro: Your account has been created and linked to your profile in the clan record. One thing is left: choose a password, so that from now on you can sign in yourself.
setPassword.oneTimeNote: This link works once and expires after thirty minutes. If it runs out, a new one can be arranged straight away — nothing is lost.
setPassword.hint: At least 8 characters. Write it down somewhere safe — nobody in the system can read this password.
setPassword.errorEmpty: Please type the password you want to use.
setPassword.errorMismatch: The two entries do not match yet. Press “Show” to see what you typed.
setPassword.rejectedFallback: This password cannot be used yet. Usually it is too short or too easy to guess — try a longer phrase, at least 8 characters, and avoid your own name or date of birth.

PROVIDER_DOWN.title: Could not reach the account system
PROVIDER_DOWN.body: This is a problem on the server side, not with the password you typed. That password has not been saved.
PROVIDER_DOWN.next: The link is still valid. Please wait a moment and press “Set password” again.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Please wait a moment and try again
RATE_LIMITED.body: This page has just received several attempts in a row, so it is pausing briefly. That is how we stop strangers guessing passwords — you have not done anything wrong.
RATE_LIMITED.next: The link is still valid. Please wait a few minutes and press “Set password” again.

UNAVAILABLE.title: Could not send it
UNAVAILABLE.body: The connection between your device and the server is having trouble. The password you typed has not been saved, and there is nothing wrong with the password itself.
UNAVAILABLE.next: The link is still valid. Please press “Set password” again.

setPassword.doneTitle: All done — your password is set
setPassword.doneBody: From now on you sign in with the password you just chose. Your profile in the clan record is already linked to this account; there is no approval to wait for.
setPassword.doneWhatsThere: Once you sign in, you can see:
setPassword.doneItem1: the phả đồ (clan tree), including living members of your own chi (branch)
setPassword.doneItem2: danh xưng lookups — what to call whom, correctly
setPassword.doneItem3: giỗ (death anniversary) reminders for your own branch, by the lunar calendar
setPassword.doneCta: Sign in and open the clan tree
setPassword.expiredTitle: This password link can no longer be used
setPassword.expiredAccountSafe: Your account is still there and still linked to your profile in the clan record. Only this link has run out — you do not need a new invitation code, and you do not have to start again.
setPassword.expiredBody: The link opens only within thirty minutes of accepting the invitation, and only once — so that a message forwarded to the wrong person cannot open your account.
setPassword.expiredNext: Please call the person who invited you. They can set a temporary password for you and read it out over the phone; the very first time you sign in, the system will invite you to change it there and then.
setPassword.expiredAlreadySetCta: I already set my password — sign in
setPassword.expiredAlreadySetHint: If you opened this link once before and finished setting a password, that password still works: you only need to sign in.
setPassword.noLinkTitle: Your account already has a password
setPassword.noLinkBody: This page is used exactly once, when an account is first created. The system deliberately does not open it for an account that already has a password — if it did, anyone holding an invitation code could change your password.
setPassword.noLinkNext: Please press “Sign in” and use the password you normally use. If you have forgotten it, call the person who invited you and ask for a reset.

notProvisioned.title: We could not find you in the phả
notProvisioned.body: You are logged in, but this account has not yet been linked to anyone in the phả. So there is no profile to open yet, and danh xưng cannot be looked up.
notProvisioned.todo: Please call your trưởng chi (branch head), or the person who invited you, and tell them the account is not linked to a profile in the phả. Linking is a decision of the Hội đồng Tộc biểu (clan council) — nobody else can do it, not even you.

notActive.title: Your membership is awaiting approval
notActive.body: You are logged in. The Hội đồng Tộc biểu (clan council) has one more confirmation to make before the part about living people opens.
notActive.todo: The part about the ancestors who have passed away is already open to you — see below. If you have been waiting a long time with no reply, please call your trưởng chi (branch head).

s1.name: The Council settles the original genealogy
s1.detail: A signed paper copy. It is the reference for every later reconciliation — no software does this step.

s2.name: Declare the chi / ngành structure
s2.detail: Declare the branches, then assign each one to a branch head. Only then does a branch have the code prefix its Excel template needs.

s3.name: Each branch fills in its Excel file
s3.detail: Four branches work in parallel, not in turn. Each downloads its own template and copies from its own paper book.

s4.name: Reconcile, fix, upload again
s4.detail: Upload, read what the system reports, fix it in Excel, upload again — until it is clean. Nothing changes in the genealogy during this step.

s5.name: Invite living relatives to claim their own record
s5.detail: Nobody fills in a living person's details for them. They receive a Zalo invitation and declare their own.

intro.lead: This page tells you where you are in the process and what comes next.

reassure.title: Nothing here can damage the genealogy
reassure.body: An uploaded file sits in a holding area. The clan's genealogy only changes when you have read the reconciliation report and pressed approve yourself — and even then you can undo the whole batch for 30 days.

resume.title: You have a batch in progress
resume.body: Batch {batchId} for {branch}, uploaded {when}. Work in progress lives on the server, so you can close the browser and pick it up whenever you like.

actions.progress: See how each branch is doing

intro.sessionNote: Entering a branch of 350–400 people usually takes 6–10 sittings. There is no need to finish in one go.

template.title: Excel template, one per branch
template.lead: Every branch gets its own template. From the second import onwards it comes pre-filled with the people already in your branch — edit the rows that already have codes instead of retyping them.

guide.title: Four things to know before you start

sheets.title: The file has five sheets
sheets.body: Instructions · People · Marriages · Lists · Already recorded. The Instructions sheet opens first — read it before typing a single row.

code.title: The Code column matters most
code.body: Codes come from the numbering in your branch's paper register; the workbook explains the format. Father code and mother code point back at this column. The next import reuses the same codes, so never renumber.

lunar.title: Lunar death dates are typed as text
lunar.body: Type 15/8 or 15/8 nhuận. The cell is already formatted as text — do not change it, or Excel will silently turn 15/8 into a solar date in the current year.

living.title: Do not fill in details for living people
living.body: The template deliberately has no phone, email, address or photo column. Living relatives declare their own details at step 5. This is a decision, not an omission.

example.title: Delete the example rows before you submit
example.body: The People sheet ships with a three-generation family as an example, on a different background. Delete those rows before uploading.

template.next: Finished filling it in? Upload the file

upload.title: Upload a file
upload.lead: Choose the branch and the completed Excel file. The system reads and reconciles it; nothing is written to the genealogy.
upload.branchLabel: Which branch is this file for
upload.limits: Only .xlsx files, at most 10 MB and 5,000 person rows.
upload.reassure: Uploading is not approving. You will see the full reconciliation report before deciding to write anything.
upload.supersede: A new upload replaces the branch's batch in progress. The old batch is not deleted, it just stops being the one in use.

alreadyCommitted.title: This exact file has already been written into the tree
alreadyCommitted.body: This branch already has a batch with the same contents that was committed. This is only a double-click guard — re-uploading to VALIDATE is never blocked. If you really mean to write it again, use the button below.

openBatch.title: This branch still has a batch under review
openBatch.body: Batch {batchId} is not closed yet. Uploading a new file replaces it — it becomes “superseded” and the reconciliation work already done there cannot be continued. If you meant to carry on with the old batch, open it.

notWritten.title: Nothing has been written to the genealogy yet
notWritten.body: Your file is in the holding area. The clan's genealogy has not changed by one row and will only change when you press the approve button at the bottom of this page.

counts.update: {count} already exist and would be updated

blocking.title: {count} errors you must fix
blocking.help: These must be fixed in the Excel file and the file uploaded again. Until then, approval is not possible.
blocking.cycle: The loop found in the file
blocking.conflictRows: {count, plural, one {Clashes with row {rows}} other {Clashes with rows {rows}}}

warning.title: {count} items to look over
warning.help: These can still be imported. Read them so you know what you are accepting, then confirm below.
warning.ack: I have looked over all {count} items
warning.ackAgain: I have reviewed the {count} items again
warning.mayBeStale: The approval gate is still closed. If you acknowledged earlier, the validator has most likely added new items since — an acknowledgement only counts for the exact list that was read.

actions.reuploadHint: Fix it in Excel — where you are at home — then upload again. Use “Re-run the validator” when the file has not changed and you only want to check again.

commit.button: Approve and write {count} people into the genealogy
commit.blockedByIssues: {count} errors still to fix — approval is not possible yet
commit.blockedByAck: Confirm you have looked over the items before approving
commit.confirmBody: This is the moment the clan tree changes. If something turns out wrong you can still roll the whole batch back — as long as nobody has edited the records it created.
commit.blockedByStatus: The batch is in state {status}, not ready for approval
commit.blockedUnknown: The server is not allowing this batch to be approved.
commit.blockedByAckStale: The validator produced new items to review after you acknowledged — read the new ones and acknowledge again

committing.title: Writing to the genealogy
committing.estimate: {done}/{total} rows — this figure is an estimate
committing.leaveOk: You may close this page; the write carries on.

rollback.confirmBody: Every person and relationship this batch brought in will be taken back out of the genealogy. Nothing is permanently deleted.
rollback.done: This batch has been removed from the genealogy
rollback.blockedHint: Rolling back now would discard other people's work. Talk to them first, or ask the council to correct the records one by one.
rollback.reasonOptional: Optional, but the reason goes into the audit log and whoever comes next will need it.
rollback.doneNote: This batch has been rolled out of the tree. Its status stays “Committed” because it was once written — that is historical fact, not a display bug.

superseded.title: This batch was replaced by a newer upload
superseded.body: There is nothing to do with the old batch. Open the newest one to carry on reconciling.

failed.title: This batch stopped because of blocking errors

duplicates.title: Reviewing suspected duplicates
duplicates.lead: The system only orders them for review. The decision is yours — nothing is merged automatically.

columns.existingInFile: Another row in the same file

duplicates.evidenceTitle: Evidence, ordered by how far it can be trusted
duplicates.trustNote: The lunar death date comes first because the whole clan observes it every year, so it is hard to get wrong. Birth year comes last because old books usually record it from memory — a year or two apart does not mean two different people.
duplicates.missingWarning: The highlighted items are missing from the file. Merging keeps what the genealogy already holds; it never overwrites it with a blank.

decide.defer: Not sure — leave it for later
decide.deferHint: Choose this when you are not sure. The pair stays in the holding area until someone can ask the elders — but the batch still cannot be approved while any pair is undecided.
decide.preselected: A very high score — the system suggests merging, but it still waits for you.
decide.notePlaceholder: For example: checked against the 1998 Giap branch book
decide.noteHint: The note goes into the audit log under your name. Ten years from now it is the only sentence explaining why.
decide.failed: The decision could not be saved

duplicates.policy: The detector only raises a suspicion from {suspect} points, and suggests merging from {preselect}. Both thresholds are published by the server.
duplicates.privacyNote: For someone already in the tree this screen receives only a key — no name, no birth year, no death anniversary. The detector scans the whole clan, so the suspected record may sit in a branch you are not allowed to see.
duplicates.evidenceWithheld: There is no comparison table for this pair: the system does not send the tree person's data into the import screens. Open their profile to see whatever you are allowed to see.

treeParty.notVisibleTitle: You are not allowed to view this person
treeParty.notVisibleBody: The duplicate detector scans the whole clan, so the suspected record may belong to another branch. The system does not reveal whether such a record exists.
treeParty.notVisibleAsk: Ask the clan council to compare for you — they can see both sides.
treeParty.loadFailed: Could not load the tree record. Try again in a few minutes.

duplicates.noSignals: The server sent no signal label for this pair.

plan.title: What will be written after your decisions
plan.update: {count} people already exist and will be updated
plan.why: Each time you choose “merge”, one row moves from “added” to “updated” or disappears entirely — the two numbers above follow. The server recomputes them; this screen never adds them up itself.
plan.gateOpen: Everything is decided. Go back to reconciliation to approve the batch.
plan.gateClosed: The batch cannot be approved: {count} pairs are still undecided. “Deferred” still counts as undecided.

mergeNotApplicable.title: Cannot merge: this row is tied to two people already in the genealogy
mergeNotApplicable.body: You chose “one person” for two pairs on the same row, but those pairs point at two different records that already exist in the genealogy. One row cannot be both of them.
mergeNotApplicable.scope: Merging two records that are already in the genealogy belongs to the person-management screens, not to data import: only there is the full edit history and the authority to join two nodes of the tree.
mergeNotApplicable.whatToDo: Set one of the two pairs back to “two different people”, then re-run validation. If two tree records genuinely need to become one, ask the clan council to do that first.
mergeNotApplicable.batchStopped: The batch has stopped because of this error. Nothing has been written to the genealogy.

progress.title: How each branch is doing
progress.lead: The four branches work in parallel. This table shows what is still missing in each.
progress.notARanking: This is not a league table. The branches have different books, different sizes and different numbers of people free to help — comparing one with another says nothing.
progress.noCoordinator: Nobody has taken this branch on
progress.noCoordinatorHint: A branch with nobody responsible stands still no matter how ready the software is. That is the Council's to solve.
progress.missingGio: {count} deceased people with no giỗ date
progress.missingGioWhy: Someone with no giỗ date still appears on the tree but will never trigger a death-anniversary reminder.
progress.yoursToImport: You are assigned to import this branch
progress.notYoursToImport: You do not import for this branch
progress.expectedUncounted: Nobody has counted the paper register yet

hint.DEATH_LUNAR: Observed by the whole clan every year, so it is hard to get wrong — the most trustworthy line here.
hint.BIRTH_YEAR: Old books usually record it from memory; a year or two apart is common.

problem.IMP_BAD_FORMAT: Wrong file format. Only genuine .xlsx files are accepted.
problem.IMP_CORRUPT_FILE: The file is corrupt and cannot be opened. Re-open it in Excel and save a fresh copy.
problem.IMP_UNSAFE_FILE: The file contains content that is unsafe to read. Please use the template downloaded from this system.
problem.IMP_MISSING_SHEET: The file is missing the Nhân khẩu sheet. Use your branch's template.
problem.IMP_MISSING_COLUMN: The file is missing a required column of the template.
problem.IMP_TOO_MANY_ROWS: Too many rows (limit 5,000). Split it into smaller files.
problem.IMP_FILE_TOO_LARGE: File too large. The limit is 10 MB — usually caused by embedded images.
problem.IMP_ALREADY_COMMITTED: This exact file has already been written into the tree for this branch.
problem.IMP_BLOCKING_ISSUES_PRESENT: There are still errors to fix in the file.
problem.IMP_WARNINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: The items needing review have not been acknowledged.
problem.IMP_DUPLICATES_UNDECIDED: Some suspected duplicate pairs are still undecided.
problem.IMP_BATCH_CLOSED: This batch is closed. Upload a new one instead of editing it.
problem.IMP_COMMIT_BLOCKED: The write stopped before writing because the batch hit a case the clan's conventions have not answered. Not a single row entered the tree.
problem.IMP_ROLLBACK_REFUSED: Cannot roll back: someone has already edited records this batch created.
problem.BRANCH_SCOPE_VIOLATION: This branch is outside the scope you were assigned.
problem.ACCOUNT_NOT_PROVISIONED: Your account has not been provisioned yet. Please sign in again.
problem.UNKNOWN: That did not go through. Try again in a few minutes.
problem.IMP_MERGE_NOT_APPLICABLE: Cannot merge: this row is tied to two different records that already exist in the genealogy. Merging existing records belongs to the person-management screens.

rows.summary: Preview rows: {create} to create, {update} to update
rows.why: The “What happens” column answers the one question that matters on a second upload: will re-uploading create duplicate people? “Update” means this code already belongs to someone in the tree and will edit that exact person.
rows.caption: Rows currently staged

workbook.download: Download the issue list as Excel
workbook.hint: The workbook has three sheets: Overview, Must fix, Worth reviewing. Fix it in Excel — where you are at home — then upload the corrected file again.
workbook.failed: The file could not be downloaded

claim.pageDescription: Pick your own node on the phả đồ, then send a request for the Trưởng chi to check.

start.title: Find myself in the phả
start.lead: You have registered and you can see the phả đồ (the clan tree). What is left is to point at your own node, so that the Trưởng chi (head of your chi, a lineage branch) can link this account to it.
start.step1: Open the phả đồ and look for yourself — type your name into the search box on the tree.
start.step2: Tap your own node, then choose “This is me”.
start.step3: Give a phone number and a few lines about yourself, then send it to the Trưởng chi.
start.openTree: Open the phả đồ and look for myself
start.openTreeHint: The search box sits on the tree itself. Typing with or without Vietnamese accents both work.
start.notInTree: I am not in the phả yet
start.notInTreeHint: For a newly married con dâu or con rể (daughter- or son-in-law), a newborn, or a branch abroad that the paper phả stopped recording.
start.pendingTitle: You have already sent a request

target.heading: The node you picked
target.confirm: Is this really you? If not, please go back to the phả đồ and pick another node.
target.back: Pick another node on the phả đồ

quota.lastOne: This is your last request. Please write the part about yourself carefully.
quota.why: The number of requests is capped so that nobody can work through the clan one person at a time.

form.title: Send a request to claim this node
form.lead: The Trưởng chi will read what you write to check it against what they know, then call this number to confirm.
form.phoneHint: The Trưởng chi calls this number to confirm. Once the request is approved the number is saved to your hồ sơ (person record) but stays closed — you decide who may see it.
form.introductionHint: Whose son or daughter are you? Where is your quê quán (ancestral home)? This is what the Trưởng chi actually checks against — the phone number only lets them call you.
form.introductionPlaceholder: I am the second child of Nguyễn Văn Cẩn and Trần Thị Lan, from Đại Lan, Nam Định. I was born in 1992 and live in Hà Nội.
form.submit: Send the request to the Trưởng chi

errors.phoneRequired: Please give a phone number so the Trưởng chi can call you back.
errors.phoneTooShort: This phone number looks too short. Please check it.
errors.introductionRequired: Please write a few lines about yourself. Without them the Trưởng chi has nothing to check against.
errors.introductionTooShort: Please write a little more — at least whose child you are and where your quê quán is.
errors.introductionTooLong: This is longer than {max} characters. Please shorten it.

newPerson.title: I am not in the phả yet
newPerson.lead: This is normal and it happens often: the phả has not caught up with a new member. Fill in the fields below and the Trưởng chi will review them and write you into the phả.
newPerson.caseSpouse: A newly married con dâu or con rể (daughter- or son-in-law) — the wedding happened before anyone updated the phả.
newPerson.caseChild: A newborn — the parents are in the phả, the child is not yet.
newPerson.caseFar: A branch abroad for generations — the chi's paper phả stopped recording it, so the whole branch is missing.
newPerson.notCreatedTitle: Sending a request is not the same as being in the phả
newPerson.notCreatedBody: Nothing has been created for you yet — this is only a request. Your hồ sơ (person record) is written, and you appear in the phả, only once the Trưởng chi approves it.
newPerson.birthYearHint: Gregorian year. It is the easiest thing for the Trưởng chi to check against.
newPerson.relativeTitle: A relative already in the phả
newPerson.relativeWhy: The phả is a tree: everyone is attached to it through a relative. With nobody named, a new record would sit outside the tree — no đời (generation) could be counted, no danh xưng (kinship term) could be looked up, and no chi would know the request is theirs to approve. That is why this is required, not merely starred.
newPerson.relativePlaceholder: Type a name to search the phả
newPerson.relationHint: One relative is enough. The Trưởng chi will ask for more if they need it.
newPerson.submit: Send the request to the Trưởng chi

errors.birthYearRequired: Please give your year of birth.
errors.birthYearRange: The year of birth must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.relativeRequired: Please name one relative already in the phả — father, mother, or spouse. Without a relative the new record cannot be attached to the tree.
errors.relationRequired: Please say whether that person is your father, your mother, or your spouse.

newPerson.formTitle: The person to add to the phả
newPerson.duplicateTitle: Request sent — you may already be in the phả
newPerson.duplicateBody: We found {count} record(s) in the phả that could be you. The Trưởng chi will check before approving — if you know exactly which node is yours on the phả đồ, please go back and pick that one instead of sending an “I am not in the phả yet” request.
newPerson.duplicateBack: Back to the phả đồ to pick the right node

deceased.title: This node belongs to someone who has died
deceased.body: {name} has died, so this is not your node. Please go back to the phả đồ and find your own.

personUnavailable.title: You cannot send a request for this person
personUnavailable.body: This node is not taking further requests. If you are certain it is you, please call your Trưởng chi and explain.
personUnavailable.action: Pick another node on the phả đồ

alreadyPending.title: You have already sent a request
alreadyPending.body: It is waiting for the Trưởng chi. Only one request can be open at a time, so please wait for an answer before sending another.

accountAlreadyLinked.title: This account is already in the phả
accountAlreadyLinked.body: Your account is already linked to a hồ sơ (person record) in the phả, so there is nothing left to request.

needsAccount.title: Please sign in first
needsAccount.body: Only someone who registered with a clan invitation code can send this request.

rateLimited.title: Please wait a moment and try again
rateLimited.body: Too many attempts have come from this device. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

unavailable.title: Cannot send it right now
unavailable.body: The connection to the server is failing. Nothing you wrote has been lost — please try again.

limitReached.title: You have used all your requests
limitReached.body: The number of requests is capped so that nobody can work through the clan one person at a time. Please call your Trưởng chi, or whoever gave you the invitation code, and ask them to do it for you.

relativeUnusable.title: The relative you named cannot be used yet
relativeUnusable.body: That relative has not been placed in any chi (lineage branch) in the phả, so the system does not yet know which Trưởng chi this request belongs to. Please name a different relative already in the phả, or call your Trưởng chi — placing someone in a chi is their work, not something you can fix.

pending.title: Your request
pending.kindNew: Asking to be written into the phả as {name}
pending.waitingFor: The request sits with {branch}, waiting for the {title} to read and check it.
pending.waitingForBranchOnly: The request sits with {branch}, waiting for the Trưởng chi to read and check it.
pending.waitingForUnknown: The request is waiting for the Trưởng chi of the chi concerned, or for the Hội đồng Tộc biểu (the clan council), to read and check it.
pending.waitingHint: They do clan work in their own time, so please allow a few days. If it takes much longer, call your Trưởng chi.
pending.notCreatedYet: Your hồ sơ (person record) has not been created. It is written, and you appear in the phả, only once the request is approved.
pending.meanwhileTitle: What you can see while you wait
pending.canTree: The phả đồ — names, đời (generation) and relations of the people in the clan.
pending.canDeceased: The full records of ancestors who have died.
pending.cannotWrite: You cannot write posts yet. Posts on the home page are the voice of people recorded in the phả, so they wait for approval.
pending.cannotPrivate: You cannot see the phone number, address or full date of birth of living people.
pending.resubmitExhausted: You have used all your requests. Please call your Trưởng chi and ask them to do it for you.
pending.approvedBody: The Trưởng chi has approved it. Your account is now linked to a record in the phả.
pending.emptyTitle: You have not sent any request
pending.emptyBody: To appear in the phả, point at your own node on the phả đồ, or fill in a new record if you are not there yet.
pending.emptyAction: Start finding myself in the phả
pending.kindExistingUnknown: Claiming the node you picked on the phả đồ
pending.cancelHint: Withdrawing costs you nothing. Once withdrawn you can send a different request straight away.
pending.cancelFailed: Could not withdraw the request right now. Please try again.

errors.notProvisioned: You need to sign in with a clan account to see this section.
errors.noReviewRight: Only branch heads and the Clan Council can review requests to join the phả.
errors.noIssueRight: Only branch heads and the Clan Council can issue invitation codes.
errors.noScope: The Clan Council has not assigned you a branch yet, so there is nobody you can invite. Please contact the Council.

queue.empty: No requests are waiting in your scope.
queue.emptyNoScope: The Clan Council has not assigned you a branch yet, so no request falls in your scope. Please contact the Council.
queue.scopeNote: {n, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} waiting in your scope.

queue.contestedLead: Look at both before choosing. Whoever sent first is not necessarily the right one — shared names are ordinary within a clan. Phoning each of them is the surest check.
queue.contestedMissing: {n, plural, one {# more request} other {# more requests}} claim this record but did not load. Please reload the page before deciding.

card.attemptNo: This is attempt number {n} from this person.
card.unnamedProposal: Applicant left the full name blank
card.deceasedClaimWarning: This request points at a deceased person. The system should have blocked it at the selection step — please tell an administrator before deciding.
card.writesToTree: Approving this writes a new person into the phả
card.writesToTreeDetail: Unlike a claim on an existing record, there is no record here yet. Approving creates one and links it into the tree. The phả never hard-deletes, so a person entered by mistake stays in the tree.

duplicate.notScanned: No duplicate scan was run for this request. Please check carefully before approving — the applicant may already be in the phả under a different name.
duplicate.none: The whole clan was scanned and nobody resembling the applicant was found.

review.approveClaimLead: Link the applicant's account to the record {name}. From now on they can edit that record and read its private fields.
review.approveNewPersonLead: Approving creates a new record named {name} in the phả.
review.newPersonConsequence1: The system creates the record and links it into the tree through the relative named above.
review.newPersonConsequence2: The phả never hard-deletes, so this person will stay in the tree.
review.newPersonConsequence3: Please re-read the close matches above — the applicant may already be in the phả under a different name.
review.contestedApproveWarning: Someone else also claims this record. Approving this one declines the others, because a record can hold only one account.

invite.title: Issue codes and invitations
invite.subtitle: The Clan Council issues a code for the whole clan; branch heads invite individual elders by name.

code.onceWarning: The code is shown once. Closing this panel means you cannot read it again — copy it or write it down now.
code.copied: Code copied. Paste it into your message now.
code.copyFailed: This device would not copy automatically. Please write the code above down by hand.
code.reissueHint: If the code is lost, issue a new one; the old one keeps its own usage counter.

clan.lead: This code is issued to the whole clan and can be used many times. Anyone holding it can register and view the phả đồ, so watch the usage counter and revoke it as soon as something looks wrong.
clan.labelPlaceholder: For example: Nguyễn clan Zalo group 2026
clan.maxUsesHint: Set it to roughly the number of people in the clan. With a cap, the code closes itself once used up.
clan.empty: No clan invitation code has been issued yet.
clan.compareToClan: {used} uses, while the clan has {living} living members.
clan.noMaxWarning: This code has no usage cap. Watch the counter closely.
clan.revokeLead: From now on nobody can register with this code. People who already joined with it are unaffected.
clan.revokeReasonPlaceholder: For example: the code was forwarded outside the clan.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many actions too quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.

personal.personPlaceholder: Type a name to search the phả
personal.personRequired: Please choose the person to invite.
personal.scopeHint: You can only invite people inside the branch assigned to you.
personal.notePlaceholder: For example: read the code out over the phone, she does not use Zalo.
personal.empty: You have not issued any invitation yet.
personal.revokeLead: From now on this code will not open anything. If the person still needs access, issue a new one.
personal.revokeReasonPlaceholder: For example: issued to the wrong person.
